description: Create js/core.js - App infrastructure including hash router, navigation renderers, theme manager, modal/sheet/overlay helpers, topbar updater, and keyboard shortcuts
steps: Implement hash router: parse location.hash to route name, support #/dashboard, #/skills, #/bosses, #/quests, #/character, #/habits, #/tasks, #/focus, #/analytics, #/achievements, #/shop, #/settings. Default to #/dashboard. Listen to hashchange event.
Implement sidebar nav renderer for desktop (#sidebar-nav): render all 12 page links using .side-link and .sl-ico classes. Mark active with .active class. Each link navigates via hash.
Implement bottom nav renderer for mobile (#bottom-nav): render 5 .nav-item elements (Dashboard, Habits, Focus, Quests, More). 'More' opens a sheet with remaining pages.

Implement theme manager: read settings.theme from LV.Data.get(), apply data-theme attribute to <html>. Support 'dark', 'light', 'system'. For 'system', use matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') and listen for changes.
Implement accent color manager: support custom accent colors via CSS custom property override on :root
Implement modal helper: showModal(contentHTML) shows #modal-layer with .modal inside, hideModal() hides it. Click backdrop to close.
Implement sheet helper: showSheet(contentHTML) shows #sheet-layer with .sheet inside (including .sheet-grip), hideSheet() hides it. Click backdrop to close.
Implement topbar updater: updateTopbar(pageTitle) sets #topbar-title text, updates #topbar-power-val with LV.Game.totalPower(), updates #topbar-coins-val with LV.Data.get().coins
Implement toast system: showToast({icon, text, type, xp}) appends .toast to #toast-layer, auto-removes after 3s with .out animation
Implement floating XP animation: showXPFloat(amount, x, y, color) creates .xp-float element at position
Implement haptics helper: haptic(type) calls navigator.vibrate() if settings.haptics is true
Implement keyboard shortcuts: 1-9 for page navigation, L for quick log
Export LV.Core with: navigate(route), showModal, hideModal, showSheet, hideSheet, updateTopbar, showToast, showXPFloat, haptic, applyTheme, initRouter, renderNav
acceptance_criteria: env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/core.js passes without errors
LV.Core is exported with navigate, showModal, hideModal, showSheet, hideSheet, updateTopbar, showToast, showXPFloat, haptic, applyTheme, initRouter, renderNav functions
Router supports all 12 routes and defaults to dashboard
Bottom nav shows Dashboard, Habits, Focus, Quests, More (5 items)
findings: js/ui.js does not exist yet (FEAT-002). core.js guards all LV.UI calls with existence checks so it works standalone. Node --check passes. All 14 exported functions verified present.
